description: Better Auth on the Drizzle branches. Two modes, selected by authMode and resolved through the *.internal.ts / *.client.ts selector suffixes: `internal` is Google-only with a server-side domain allowlist, `client` is email/password with verification, reset and invitations.

env.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
env.note: openssl rand -base64 32. Rotating it invalidates every session. Previews MUST use their own.

env.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
env.note: Same origin the app is served from, or callbacks fail.

env.name: AUTH_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
env.note: internal mode only. Comma-separated email domains permitted to sign in.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.note: Required in internal mode; optional in client mode.
